description: University Grants Commission - The Universities Provident Fund Ordinance No. 1 of 2015 which comes into force on 11.03.2015
categorisation: This gazette content establishes the "Universities Provident Fund Ordinance No. 1 of 2015" under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It creates a comprehensive legal and regulatory framework for the administration, management, and operation of a provident fund for university staff, including detailed provisions about contributions, fund administration, investment committees, and supervisory boards. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it establishes new regulations and statutory instruments.
